source.title: Newry Reporter, 6 May 1911, p. 5 ("Armagh County Council": withdrawals, contests and unopposed returns) ("Unopposed Returns")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1911: polled Wednesday 31 May 1911 in six divisions; the other fifteen were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. An earlier report said Alexander would not seek re-election (Newry Reporter, 27 April 1911, p. 8); the list of unopposed returns names him.
